items.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ken Kimery is identified in the notes as the recording engineer and speaks briefly to check tape time, but the interviewee (Bobby Hutcherson) does not mention him or interact with him personally.

ctx.x: Interviewee: Bobby Hutcherson (January 27, 1941 – August 15, 2016) with his wife Rosemary Hutcherson Interviewer: Anthony Brown with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 60 pp.
